Description: Retrieves the structural configuration and metadata of a specific bin location using its primary key ID.
Summary: Get bin details by ID

Description: Scans a bin QR HashCode and returns bin details if it currently contains unpicked stock.
Summary: Locate Checked-In Bin by QR Code

Description: Retrieves the structural configuration and metadata of a specific bin location by filtering first on its QR code hash code and warehouse ID.
Summary: Get bin details by QR code hash

Description: Retrieves active check-ins for a given bin ID, prioritizing palletized received products over direct check-in products.
Summary: Get available stock in a specific bin by ID

Description: Retrieves aggregated metrics, inventory health, activity trends, and warehouse breakdown for the dashboard.
Summary: Get dashboard summary statistics

Description: Unified inventory inspector. Resolves Pallets or Bins and returns all items stored inside.
Summary: Inspect inventory contents by scanning a Pallet or Bin QR code

Description: Creates a new pallet record in the system and returns its details.
Summary: Create a new pallet

Description: Updates all details of an existing pallet by its ID.
Summary: Update an existing pallet

Description: Creates a new product record and returns the created product details.
Summary: Create a new product

Description: Updates all details of an existing product by its ID.
Summary: Update an existing product

Description: Transfers all checked-in pallets and individual items from a source bin into new check-in records at the destination bin.
Summary: Transfer all contents from one bin to another

Description: Moves a single received product out of its current check-in into a new check-in at the destination bin.
Summary: Transfer a single item to a new bin

Description: Moves a checked-in pallet (and all its contents) from its current bin to a destination bin.
Summary: Transfer a whole pallet to a new bin

Description: Returns transfer log entries within a date range, optionally scoped to a single warehouse.
Summary: Get a transfer log report

Description: Moves a single received product out of its current check-in and into a new check-in at the destination bin, logging the transfer.
Summary: Transfer a single item to a new bin

Description: Returns item-level (non-pallet) received products currently checked in to the given bin.
Summary: List individually checked-in items in a bin

Description: Moves a checked-in pallet and its contents from its current bin into a new check-in record at the destination bin, logging the transfer.
Summary: Transfer a whole pallet to a new bin

Description: Finds a pallet by pallet number within a warehouse and returns its current bin location, if checked in.
Summary: Locate a pallet by its pallet number

Description: Finds a pallet by its QR code hash within a warehouse and returns its current bin location, if checked in.
Summary: Locate a pallet by its QR code hash

Description: Returns transfer log entries within a date range, optionally scoped to a single warehouse.
Summary: Get a transfer log report
